name: Auroom Mira S Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit
description: Auroom Mira S Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit The Auroom Mira S Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit was meticulously designed to ensure every aspect was carefully considered. The durable thermally-enhanced spruce exterior is capable of withstanding all weather conditions, while the striking thermo-aspen interior is highlighted by indirect LED bench lighting through the full tempered glass front wall. Additionally, the cabin is available in a sleek black wood finish. Enhance your outdoor space with this spacious 2-person sauna kit that boasts a high level of craftsmanship. The smooth benches and hidden fasteners showcase its premium quality, while its 2-tier design allows for optimal positioning during use. This well-designed kit can be easily assembled for professional-grade results. Door Placement: Standard - Left Hinge Only The Sauna heater is sold separately. Installation is a breeze with this sauna kit. It may be put together with help from two people within four to six hours, making it a simple do-it-yourself project. This sauna features a premium tempered glass door, crafted with a metal-wood handle for enhanced style and strength. Featuring a full front wall of tempered glass, Auroom Mira S 2 Person Outdoor Sauna provides a spacious and welcoming ambiance. This luxurious sauna is specially crafted to provide optimal comfort and superior quality. Made with thermo-aspen interior benches, whose smooth satin finish adds a premium feel, and with no visible fasteners, it is sure to provide a pleasant experience. Its small footprint makes it suitable for installation in a variety of outdoor areas. The exterior of the Auroom Mira S 2 Person Outdoor Sauna is constructed of thermally modified spruce cladding with a sleek black or natural finish, designed to resist fluctuating temperatures and weather. Highly Efficient Space Usage. This sauna is designed with maximal space efficiency, allowing for a cozier sauna experience. The sauna offers indirect LED bench lighting, paired with a backrest featuring remote-controlled LED lighting technology, to produce a luxurious sauna atmosphere. An interior-matching guard for the heater is included to enhance the overall experience. The kit includes accessories of the highest quality, such as a bucket, ladle, thermometer, hygrometer, sand timer, aroma set, sauna hat, and sauna pillow, for an upgraded sauna experience.
